# 2 Baruch Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**14:1** And-I-answered and-said: "O-LORD, behold-you-have-shown-me the-diversity-of-the-times and-what-shall-befall-after-[these]-things; and-you-have-said-to-me that-the-recompense-that-has-been-reserved-for-the-nations is-to-come.

**14:2** And-now I-know that-those-who-have-sinned are-many, and-they-have-lived-pleasantly, and-gone-to-rest in-prosperity, and-have-departed-from-this-world. And-few-are-the-nations [that]-have-been-left.

**14:3** And-many-are-those-who-have-been-taken-up-in-joy to-the-age-that-has-not-yet-come. But-the-many-who-are-alive are-troubled.

**14:4** And-what-profit is-there-in-this, that-we-live and-see-the-affliction, but-expect-the-recompense?

**14:5** How-long-shall-this-[endure]? And-when-shall-come-that-which-has-been-promised-to-us?

**14:6** For-this-world is-to-us a-weariness and-trouble. And-corruption and-death are-a-grief.

**14:7** We-come-into-the-world and-we-go-out-of-it in-pain. And-we-live-our-life in-anguish.

**14:8** But-for-what? Or-to-what-end? Or-why-do-we-come-into-the-world at-all, if-that-we-must-depart-in-grief?

**14:9** O-LORD-my-Lord, I-will-ask-you-one-thing: is-there [such] a-time-to-come when-the-Most-High will-be-found-to-have-held-back-from-creating-man, for-the-sake-of-those-who-suffer?

**14:10** If-you-had-not-purposed that-your-creature-should-come-into-the-world, what-profit-is-it-that-you-have-spoken-of-the-world-to-come?

**14:11** And-if-you-had-not-intended that-all-things-should-come-to-pass-in-the-end, what-was-the-use of-the-people whom-you-called-your-firstborn, whom-you-have-beloved?

**14:12** Or-what-profit is-there-in-that-which-you-call-a-chosen-people, seeing-they-are-to-come-to-grief-by-reason-of-the-sword?

**14:13** Or-why-did-you-spread-abroad-the-law-of-Moses and-promise-the-world-that-should-not-pass-away?

**14:14** For-this-world-which-you-have-made is-not-yet-ended-in-righteousness. You-do-not-rejoice-in-the-things-which-you-have-made.

**14:15** For-the-light-that-was-lit-before-us is-now-gone. And-we-see-darkness and-tribulation.

**14:16** And-the-world that-was-made-for-our-sake is-now-dark-to-us. And-the-ways-of-Zion-are-troubled.

**14:17** For-the-light-of-Zion has-been-darkened, and-the-foundation-of-Zion has-been-moved.

**14:18** And-nothing-of-all-the-good-things-has-come-to-pass to-us, and-the-full-time-of-evil-things has-come-upon-us.

**14:19** I-will-speak-therefore-in-this-matter before-your-presence, O-LORD-my-God. You-indeed-know-that before-you-created-the-world, you-prepared-a-judgment-seat-for-all-who-should-live upon-it."

---

*EMET notes: Baruch's theodicy reaches its climax. V.10-11 address creation-purpose. V.19 is the pivot to the divine answer. "Firstborn" = Israel (Exod 4:22). "Law of Moses" = Torah.*
